scope: Focused in-process manifest-diff diagnostic, debug profile. Not an end-to-end or comprehensive workload claim.
local_reason: Measures the actual local checkout's vendored 68k-file source manifest, not the hosted mirror or a synthetic manifest.
statistic: median elapsed nanoseconds; manifest scan and construction excluded; result construction and drop included
comparison_limit: One source file was added between the separate baseline and after scans. The controlled comparison is the preserved original-algorithm oracle versus the new diff on identical manifests within the after run, not the cross-session timings.

states: extreme signed time and unsigned size/mode

comprehensive_session_weighted_gate: not run; no broad speed claim or workload promotion
